description: Defines classes and functions for handling IP addresses and IP prefixes within the quiche networking library, including IP address representation, normalization, and comparison.

classes.name: QuicheIpAddress
classes.description: Represents an IP address, supporting IPv4 and IPv6, with methods for normalization, conversion, and comparison.

classes.name: QuicheIpPrefix
classes.description: Represents an IP prefix consisting of an IP address and a prefix length.

methods.name: IsInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the IP address object is initialized.

methods.name: address_family
methods.description: Returns the address family (IPv4 or IPv6).

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the IP address.

methods.name: Normalized
methods.description: Returns a normalized version of the IP address.

methods.name: DualStacked
methods.description: Returns an address suitable for IPv6-aware contexts.

methods.name: FromString
methods.description: Parses a string to set the IP address.

methods.name: IsIPv4
methods.description: Checks if the address is IPv4.

methods.name: IsIPv6
methods.description: Checks if the address is IPv6.

methods.name: InSameSubnet
methods.description: Checks if another address is in the same subnet.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns human-readable string of the IP prefix.
